events.action: Police at the door turned away three journalists; no reason was given in the courtroom.
The defendant was kept in handcuffs for the whole hearing; no reason was recorded.
Defense counsel received about 300 pages of evidence the evening before and asked for two weeks to prepare.
The judge refused the adjournment, citing earlier delay.
The judge did not allow the defense to cross-examine the police investigator, calling the questions not necessary; the defense objected.
The judge admitted a written statement from a second witness who did not appear; no reason for the absence was given.
